jobs.occupation: Huxley Associates Belgium - Cyber Security Program Manager
jobs.description:
Our client, a leading player in the banking sector, is seeking a Cyber Security Program Manager to drive their bank-wide cyber security strategy, with a specific focus on post-quantum cryptography and long-term cryptographic resilience. You will join our client's team as a strategic leader, defining and overseeing a high-impact portfolio of security initiatives, engaging senior stakeholders, and ensuring compliance with evolving regulations and cryptographic standards.
Interested?

If you are ready to shape the future of cyber security in banking and lead our client's transition to quantum-safe architectures, we would be pleased to receive your application.

• Cyber Security Strategy & Portfolio Management - Define the cyber security initiative strategy, translate it into a prioritized portfolio, and oversee cross-dependencies to deliver measurable business outcomes

• Roadmap Development & Execution - Develop long-term and short/medium-term roadmaps with clear priorities and budgets, then drive day-to-day delivery, removing impediments and ensuring adherence to master plans

• Post-Quantum Cryptography (Pqc) Knowledge - Apply strong Pqc fundamentals (e.g., lattice-based algorithms, hybrid encryption, NIST standardization) to guide cryptographic modernization and resilience

• Information Security Governance - Lead initiatives aligned with established security frameworks and risk management practices, ensuring compliance with group standards and external guidelines

• Stakeholder & Executive Engagement - Interact regularly with senior management and ExCo, aggregating input and translating complex topics like quantum risk and Pqc transition into clear, actionable memos

• Governance & Policy Contribution - Support policy improvements and the development of quantum-safe data security frameworks in collaboration with relevant teams

• Leadership & Communication - Drive success across disciplines, navigate technical uncertainty, and tailor messaging for both executives and technical teams

• Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills - Break down complex issues such as Pqc migration trade-offs, proactively addressing long-term cryptographic risks and immediate vulnerabilities

• Language Skills - French mandatory (fluent), with professional proficiency in English and Dutch

• Work Arrangement - Hybrid working model based in Brussels

jobs.occupation: ECommerce specialist - Waals Brabant - Dutch speaker
jobs.description:
Join a fast-growing international retail group operating across several European markets. With a strong omnichannel model combining an extensive physical store network with high-performing e-commerce platforms, the company is experiencing continued growth and digital transformation. Customer experience, innovation and operational excellence are at the heart of its strategy.

Jobomschrijving

This is a hands-on operational role for someone who likes to be at the heart of the action: monitoring online performance, solving issues, coordinating with different teams and making sure customers enjoy a smooth journey from click to delivery.

You will act as a key point of contact between E-commerce, IT, Customer Service, Logistics and external partners, ensuring that the online business runs efficiently every day.

Your Responsibilities

• Monitor the daily performance of the e-commerce platforms and key operational KPIs, identifying opportunities and potential issues.
• Ensure a smooth and reliable online customer journey, from website navigation and checkout to payment and delivery.
• Investigate and resolve operational issues, proactively identifying root causes and coordinating corrective actions.
• Act as the operational bridge between E-commerce, IT, Customer Service, Logistics, Project teams and external partners.
• Follow up on payment, delivery and order-related processes, ensuring issues are addressed quickly and efficiently.
• Coordinate the management of incidents and technical issues, prioritising them according to their impact on customers and the business.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of e-commerce processes, tools and ways of working.
• Analyse performance and operational data to identify trends, recurring issues and areas for improvement.
• Support the implementation of new e-commerce initiatives, projects and system enhancements.
• Ensure a high level of data accuracy, operational quality and customer satisfaction across the online channel.

• You have 2-5 years of experience in e-commerce operations, digital operations, online retail or a similar hands-on environment.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English; Dutch is mandatory for the role. French is a strong plus.
• You have a strong operational mindset and enjoy getting into the details to understand and solve problems.
• You are analytical, structured and solution-oriented, with a natural ability to prioritise.
• You are comfortable working cross-functionally and coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
• You don't wait for problems to solve themselves: you are proactive, hands-on and pragmatic.
• You have a genuine interest in retail, e-commerce and customer experience.
• Experience with e-commerce platforms, order management systems, payment solutions, ticketing tools or analytics platforms is a plus.

Are you ready to learn fast and make a real impact, working side by side with a small, close-knit team in Ghent? At Corlutions, we've been helping companies grow with Odoo since 2019, and we're expanding our team to do even more of that.
 

 
 

About Corlutions
 

Corlutions is a digitalization partner for small and medium-sized enterprises, specializing in Odoo-based solutions that help organizations reduce costs and increase revenue. We work closely with clients across sectors like manufacturing, construction, wholesale, and finance — always living by our principle: "Together is better."
 

 
 

What is a Business Analyst at Corlutions?
 

As a Business Analyst, your mission is to help our clients optimize their business processes through smart, well-implemented software — primarily Odoo and Business Intelligence. You'll gather and document business requirements, and translate them into clear functional specifications that guide every project.
 

You'll work closely with clients to ensure optimal use of Odoo apps such as Accounting, Point of Sales, eCommerce, Manufacturing, Inventory, Projects, Websites, Sales and more. By diving into your client's needs and processes, and providing personalized training, you'll become the go-to expert for their management solutions.
 

In your first weeks, you'll get comprehensive training before jumping into your first projects — always with the support of your mentor and colleagues. As you gain experience, you'll gain autonomy too. Collaboration stays key throughout: you'll be in regular contact with clients, developers, and the internal team.

Project Implementation (80%)

• Analyse needs, gather and document requirements, and suggest and implement solutions (configuration, development and testing) 

• Provide training 

• Follow-up and communication about ongoing tasks  

Internal improvement (20%)
 
 

• Feedback to the internal team 

• Mentoring and training 

• Feedback for improvement  

Optional: support other domains such as marketing, HR and accounting at Corlutions (impacts the % split above).

Expect real responsibility from day one, in a friendly and open environment where you'll work both independently and collaboratively. You'll take on a variety of projects across different industries, broadening your experience along the way. As a bonus, you'll go through an in-depth training provided by Odoo.

• Trainings — a real learning and development program 

• Green coworking space — we work from Pentagon, a green coworking space surrounded by water in Ghent 

• Sport activity — play any sport with colleagues, the bill might be covered!

Ready to start your adventure? Apply now
